- [ ] #35799 (size S) Work calendars: give an exception row in a seed load with no organization its own refusal reason (today it says the exception must belong to a same-organization calendar). No data is wrong; seed authors get the wrong cause. Detail: #35799.
- [ ] #35800 (size S) Work calendars: add test cells for four organization-isolation rules that hold today only by reading the code, so a later change cannot silently tie an exception to another organization's calendar. Detail: #35800.
